title: Disable chart animations across all graph components

requirements.text: In CO2Chart.tsx, add isAnimationActive={false} to all Recharts series components (Line, Bar, Area, etc.) to disable chart animations.

quotes: Kun je voor alle grafieken de animaties verwijderen? <Line type="monotone" dataKey="value" isAnimationActive={false} />

acceptanceCriteria: All Line (and any other series) components in CO2Chart.tsx have isAnimationActive={false}
No animation plays when the CO2 chart renders or updates

constraints: Only add isAnimationActive={false} to series-level components (Line, Bar, Area, Pie, Scatter, etc.) — do not modify chart container components or other props
Do not change any other chart logic, zoom, brush, or data-fetching behavior
nonGoals: Changing chart data sources or parsing
Adding new chart features or visual redesigns
